article_context: 从风能、太阳能成本快速下降谈起，说明可再生能源在全球电力结构中的份额持续上升，电池储能和电动车投资又进一步改善其稳定供能能力。

article.title: 阅读 Text 2 · 可再生能源正在从“政策选择”变成市场趋势
article.background: 从风能、太阳能成本快速下降谈起，说明可再生能源在全球电力结构中的份额持续上升，电池储能和电动车投资又进一步改善其稳定供能能力。

sentences.en: While fossil fuels - coal, oil, gas - still generate roughly 85 percent of the world's energy supply, it's clearer than ever that the future belongs to renewable sources such as wind and solar.
sentences.zh: 尽管煤、石油和天然气等化石燃料仍提供全球约85%的能源，但未来属于风能、太阳能等可再生能源，这一点已经比以往任何时候都更加清楚。

segments.text: While fossil fuels - coal, oil, gas - still generate roughly 85 percent of the world's energy supply, it's clearer than ever that the future belongs to renewable sources such as wind and solar.

sentences.en: The move to renewables is picking up momentum around the world: They now account for more than half of new power sources going on line.
sentences.zh: 全球向可再生能源转型的势头正在加快：如今新增投运的电力来源中，可再生能源已占一半以上。

segments.text: The move to renewables is picking up momentum around the world: They now account for more than half of new power sources going on line.

sentences.en: Some growth stems from a commitment by governments and farsighted businesses to fund cleaner energy sources.
sentences.zh: 这部分增长源于各国政府和有远见的企业承诺为更清洁的能源投入资金。

segments.text: Some growth stems from a commitment by governments and farsighted businesses to fund cleaner energy sources.

sentences.en: But increasingly the story is about the plummeting prices of renewables, especially wind and solar.
sentences.zh: 但越来越关键的原因，是可再生能源的价格正在大幅下跌，尤其是风能和太阳能。

segments.text: But increasingly the story is about the plummeting prices of renewables, especially wind and solar.

sentences.en: The cost of solar panels has dropped by 80 percent and the cost of wind turbines by close to one-third in the past eight years.
sentences.zh: 过去八年里，太阳能电池板的成本下降了80%，风力涡轮机的成本也下降了近三分之一。

segments.text: The cost of solar panels has dropped by 80 percent and the cost of wind turbines by close to one-third in the past eight years.

sentences.en: In many parts of the world renewable energy is already a principal energy source.
sentences.zh: 在世界许多地区，可再生能源已经成为主要能源来源。

segments.text: In many parts of the world renewable energy is already a principal energy source.

sentences.en: In Scotland, for example, wind turbines provide enough electricity to power 95 percent of homes.
sentences.zh: 例如在苏格兰，风力涡轮机提供的电力足以满足95%的家庭用电。

segments.text: In Scotland, for example, wind turbines provide enough electricity to power 95 percent of homes.

sentences.en: While the rest of the world takes the lead, notably China and Europe, the United States is also seeing a remarkable shift.
sentences.zh: 尽管世界其他地区，尤其是中国和欧洲，走在前面，美国也正在经历显著转变。

segments.text: While the rest of the world takes the lead, notably China and Europe, the United States is also seeing a remarkable shift.

sentences.en: In March, for the first time, wind and solar power accounted for more than 10 percent of the power generated in the US, reported the US Energy Information Administration.
sentences.zh: 美国能源信息署报告称，今年3月，美国风能和太阳能发电量首次超过全国发电总量的10%。

segments.text: In March, for the first time, wind and solar power accounted for more than 10 percent of the power generated in the US, reported the US Energy Information Administration.

sentences.en: President Trump has underlined fossil fuels - especially coal - as the path to economic growth.
sentences.zh: 时任总统特朗普把化石燃料，尤其是煤炭，强调为推动经济增长的一条路径。

segments.text: President Trump has underlined fossil fuels - especially coal - as the path to economic growth.

sentences.en: In a recent speech in Iowa, he dismissed wind power as an unreliable energy source.
sentences.zh: 他不久前在艾奥瓦州的一次演讲中称风能并不是可靠的能源来源。

segments.text: In a recent speech in Iowa, he dismissed wind power as an unreliable energy source.

sentences.en: But that message did not play well with many in Iowa, where wind turbines dot the fields and provide 36 percent of the state's electricity generation - and where tech giants like Microsoft are being attracted by the availability of clean energy to power their data centers.
sentences.zh: 但这一说法并未得到许多艾奥瓦人的认同；当地田野间遍布风力涡轮机，风电占全州发电量的36%，而微软等科技巨头也被这里能够为数据中心供电的清洁能源吸引而来。

segments.text: But that message did not play well with many in Iowa, where wind turbines dot the fields and provide 36 percent of the state's electricity generation - and where tech giants like Microsoft are being attracted by the availability of clean energy to power their data centers.

sentences.en: The question "what happens when the wind doesn't blow or the sun doesn't shine?" has provided a quick put-down for skeptics.
sentences.zh: “要是没有风、也没有阳光怎么办？”这个问题一直是怀疑者用来迅速否定可再生能源的常见说法。

segments.text: The question "what happens when the wind doesn't blow or the sun doesn't shine?" has provided a quick put-down for skeptics.

sentences.en: But a boost in the storage capacity of batteries is making their ability to keep power flowing around the clock more likely.
sentences.zh: 但电池储能能力的提升，正使可再生能源实现全天候持续供电变得越来越可行。

segments.text: But a boost in the storage capacity of batteries is making their ability to keep power flowing around the clock more likely.

sentences.en: The advance is driven in part by vehicle manufacturers, who are placing big bets on battery-powered electric vehicles.
sentences.zh: 这一进步部分由汽车制造商推动，他们正在电池驱动的电动汽车上投入重注。

segments.text: The advance is driven in part by vehicle manufacturers, who are placing big bets on battery-powered electric vehicles.

sentences.en: Although electric cars are still a rarity on roads now, this massive investment could change the picture rapidly in coming years.
sentences.zh: 尽管如今道路上的电动汽车仍不多见，但如此大规模的投资可能在未来几年迅速改变局面。

segments.text: Although electric cars are still a rarity on roads now, this massive investment could change the picture rapidly in coming years.

sentences.en: While there's a long way to go, the trend lines for renewables are spiking.
sentences.zh: 尽管前路依然漫长，可再生能源的发展曲线正在陡然上扬。

segments.text: While there's a long way to go, the trend lines for renewables are spiking.

sentences.en: The pace of change in energy sources appears to be speeding up - perhaps just in time to have a meaningful effect in slowing climate change.
sentences.zh: 能源来源的转变似乎正在加速——也许恰好来得及对减缓气候变化产生实质性作用。

segments.text: The pace of change in energy sources appears to be speeding up - perhaps just in time to have a meaningful effect in slowing climate change.

sentences.en: What Washington does - or doesn't do - to promote alternative energy may mean less and less at a time of a global shift in thought.
sentences.zh: 在全球观念正在转变之际，华盛顿为推动替代能源做什么、或不做什么，影响可能会越来越小。

segments.text: What Washington does - or doesn't do - to promote alternative energy may mean less and less at a time of a global shift in thought.
